The information workshop "Learning with University Students! Introduction to ChatGPT～AI Experience for Everyday Life～" has reached capacity and registration is now closed.

【Workshop Details】
Date and Time: Saturday, December 5, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 1:00 PM–3:00 PM
Venue: Hanno City Library, 2nd Floor Multipurpose Hall
Instructor: Student staff from Surugadai University
Capacity: 10 people (first come, first served)
Target Audience: Beginners with generative AI "ChatGPT" (those with a smartphone)
Fee: Free
What to Bring: Smartphone, charger, writing materials

【Content】
You will learn the basic operations of generative AI "ChatGPT" (such as account creation), hands-on practice, and important precautions for safely enjoying generative AI. Student staff from Surugadai University will explain the operating methods step by step.

【Important Note】
Entry after the workshop has started is not permitted.

Inquiries: Hanno City Library  TEL 042-972-2114

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/event/post-433.html
